raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 re-delivered 333 transactions that already exist in the batch, with txn_ts in epoch-milliseconds (e.g. 1768716039000 = 2026-01-18 06:00:39 UTC, the same instant as the ISO copy). The cast fails on that format, and the duplicates would double-count amounts if the epoch format were simply parsed. Parsing both formats and keeping one row per txn_id (the earliest ingest_ts) gives the correct silver table, since the duplicate copies agree on every business field.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(parsed_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(parsed_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS parsed_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') t QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) = 1;"}}
